name: Mad Packs | 3.5g Pre-Packaged Flower | Candy Bonez
description: Candy Bonez hits that perfect sweet-meets-sinister lane — a candy-coated strain with a little edge under the surface. The flavor opens with bright, sugary fruit notes that melt into a creamy, almost marshmallow-like finish, while a subtle hint of gas gives it that “Bonez” bite. The effects come on smooth and uplifting at first, lifting the mood and sharpening the senses before settling into a warm, body-loosening relaxation that never gets too heavy.
